children: BEML shares gained over 3% in morning trade on Friday after the company bagged an order worth over Rs 5,400 crore from National High Speed Rail Corporation Ltd (NHSRCL) for the Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (MAHSR) corridor.
Shares of BEML were trading at Rs 2,087 on the NSE at 10:57 am, up 3.66% from the previous close. The stock had touched an intraday high of Rs 2,121.

The order covers the supply and maintenance of high-speed rolling stock and allied works for the MAHSR corridor, according to BEML's regulatory filing. The company said the order was received in the normal course of business.

title: BEML shares gain over 3% after Rs 5,400 crore high-speed rail order win
